test_title: PYST 23: SSC JE EE- General Awareness (Held on: 22 March 2021 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following statement is** incorrect **about a body undergoing a uniform circular motion?

options.text: In Uniform Circular Motion the body moving in circle is accelerating
In Uniform Circular Motion the body is changing direction but the speed remains constant
In Uniform Circular Motion the velocity of body remains constant

solution: The correct answer is** **__**In Uniform Circular Motion the velocity of the body remains constant**__**.** • In **Uniform Circular Motion** the velocity of a body remains constant is the** incorrect **option for **uniform circular motion.** ​
